q: Islands unlock by paying a Tribute (5 items) at the new Sky-Bridge Shrine north of the Center. In what order can Islands be unlocked?
ctx: Celestial Peak (final Island) moves north, behind the Shrine, and always comes last. Rings: Mine/Fishing/Farm open at the start; Grove/Volcano after any 2 of those.
o: In rings: choose freely within each ring
Fixed order: Mine, Fishing, Farm, Grove, Volcano, then Celestial
Any order (except Celestial last); Tribute items decide what is reachable

q: How many requester NPCs per Island?
ctx: Each NPC has 3 requests and unlocks a new building and/or utilities. Each NPC needs a sprite, a portrait and a small prop.
o: 2 per Island, 1 on Celestial (13 NPCs, 39 requests)

q: How does an NPC's request menu open up?
ctx: Requests never block Island unlocks or the ending; they are optional upgrades.
o: Requests I and II open together (you pick); III opens after both
All 3 open at once; pick any
Strict chain: one at a time, I then II then III

q: How are request (and Shrine Tribute) items delivered?
o: Right-click feeding like the Dragon, and wisp lanterns can deliver too
A Deliver button that pulls from Storehouses on that Island

q: With no ascension, what is the ending?
ctx: Main path without requests is about 2:10 to the Gate; with about half the requests, about 3 h.
o: Build the Heavenly Gate on Celestial Peak, then the ending plays and free play continues
Same, but the Gate also needs some requests done (e.g. 15 of 39)
Awakening the Dragon is the ending; the Gate is removed
